narrative: WhatsApp text claiming to be Bank Security alerting you of a blocked card.

message.body: ALERT: Suspicious transaction of ₹24,500 detected on your Apex Credit Card. Card will be permanently blocked in 15 minutes unless you share the security verification code sent to your phone.

evidence.label: Request for OTP/Code
evidence.value: Asks for security verification code via chat

evidence.label: Bank Logo Profile Picture
evidence.value: Displays Apex Bank official crest image

evidence.label: Apex Bank Mobile App Hotline
evidence.value: App shows card status ACTIVE; security officer states banks never ask for codes over chat.

consequence_text.safe: Calling Apex Bank using the number on your credit card confirmed your card was active and no transaction occurred.
consequence_text.unsafe: Sharing the code would have authorized an unauthorized financial transfer (simulated).

teaching_point: Transfer strategy: Official institutions will never ask for authentication codes or passwords over messaging apps.
